game.name: walker-lane-tactics-jiean-yin
game.note: All 121 authored files (and the .uid files) are byte-identical to the a7 blobs.

components.explanation: animations/wave.tres: a frame track keying FlagSprite:frame 0-3 at 0/0.125/0.25/0.375 s, step 0.125, length 0.5, LOOP_LINEAR, no key at length (the seam rule), plus a discrete offset track 0/-4/-2/+1 for the sheet's pole drift (B03, B05). game/goal_flag.tscn: Sprite2D hframes 4 x vframes 1 on assets/art/flag/flag_red.png (Fokko, CC0, as downloaded), AnimationPlayer autoplay wave, callback mode IDLE; instanced in game/main.tscn at (1176, 458), z 1. Results: B04, B06.

animations/shoot.tres: three value tracks (Rig:position, Rig/Upper:rotation, Rig/Upper/Bow:rotation) keyed at frames 0/12/33/40/48 of a 60 fps phase table (step 1/60, length 0.8, LOOP_NONE), the bow's frame-48 key tuned 20 -> 8 degrees (B10, B18). game/archer_rig.tscn: Mount > Rig > Lower, Upper > UpperSprite, Bow > BowSprite, regions of the A2 draw art, AnimationPlayer MANUAL with root_node Mount. Results: B11, B19.

game/piece.gd: POSE_CLIPS (draw -> shoot); _apply_clip() stops, plays and advance(0)s the rig's player on set_state (lines 109-116, B12); tick(dt) advances it by game time inside main._process after the cues (lines 181-182, B14); Mount is the only node piece.gd writes on the rig. game/main.gd owns the state machine and the cue list that sets the poses. Results: B13 (interrupts), B15 (clocks).

tests/test_flag_readback.gd (43 checks: frame range, discrete updates, step, loop mode, seam; B07) and test_shoot_readback.gd (51: track_problems branched on track type, key times, step, loop mode; B16); test_anim_states.gd (51) and test_shoot_edges.gd (102: P, R, Enter one frame before/on/after frames 0, 12, 33, 48; B20); test_pins_a7.gd (29, before and after the clips); test_report.gd, route_runner.gd and fixtures/win_route.json. previews/shoot_preview (.tscn/.gd) is the fixture for Jiean's strips (B19). Results: B08, B17, B21.
project.godot: main scene res://game/main.tscn and the Compatibility renderer (line 25), 1280 x 720 (B02).
